title: Crispy cumin beef on a big leafy salad

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every item is a plain whole food or a basic staple such as tinned chickpeas, Greek yoghurt and crusty bread.

supermarket.reason: Beef mince, chickpeas, salad leaves, radishes and yoghurt are everyday Tesco items at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a frying pan, a knife, a board and a bowl, and the technique is simple frying.

works.reason: 400g mince stretched with a tin of chickpeas, 250g leaves, yoghurt and bread makes a sensible warm salad for four, with clear heat and timings.

honest_times.reason: Slicing one onion and the radishes, crushing garlic and chopping mint fits within 20 minutes, and the 15-minute cook matches the 10 plus 5 minutes of frying.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the mint and cumin, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A big bowl of leaves and radishes under warm beef suits an early May evening, and the leaves form the bulk of the dish rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a balanced family dinner of beef, pulses, fresh leaves and yoghurt with bread.
